heading: **17 February 2026**
body:
*HTFS ligation purification*

Pool the 2 reactions of each type \- 147 & N40

Add 0.2 uL 10% SDS & 0.4 uL Proteinase K. Incubate at RT for 20-30 mins.

Use Ampure XP beads to purify the ligation products. Measure concentration of   
products using Qubit.

*Linearize Plasmid FS samples*

![](assets/img/doc3-image13.png)

We use 7.5 uL of DNA, 1.5 uL Cas9 RNP, 1 uL Nuclease reaction buffer.

*Native Gel for ELF2 nucleosome experiment*

1. ELF2lig   
2. ELF2lig \+ EcoRV  
3. ELF2lignuc \+ EcoRV  
4. ELF2lig \+ ELF2 prot \+ EcoRV  
5. ELF2lignuc \+ ELF2 prot \+ EcoRV

Run the gel at 200 V, 90 mins on ice.

*Nucleosome recon for genomic DNA samples*

If we use 4 ug of DNA in a total of 25 uL volume:

Molarity of DNA \= 12.33 nM

Molarity of octamer required \= 740 nM ⇒ 2.01 ug in 25 uL solution

Prepare WT octamer stock → 0.402 ug/uL → 0.75 uL Octamer \+ 9.25 uL refolding buffer:glycerol \[1.075 M\]

5 uL of the octamer stock to be added to each of the DNA-salt mixes (20 uL) ⇒ Final salt concentration of the mix ⇒ 1.82 M

*lig147 PCR 2*

| **Final diluted DNA** | **800** |

| **NCAP\_F (10 µM)** | **250** |

25 uL per well in two 96-well plates.

| 98°C | 3 min |

*Manual curation of 2X Phusion Master Mix*

0.04 U/uL polymerase

2X Phusion HF Buffer

3 mM MgCl2

1.6 mM dNTPs

I need enough of this mix for about 4 X 100 PCR reactions (25 uL per reaction)

12.5 X 400 \= 5000 uL
